found: Rule-based fallback quoted CV snippets ending in “…”, so the new quote check rejected every one of them.
fix: Quotes are copied word-for-word; validator compares normalised text.

found: Live test: the agent noticed the uploaded CV belonged to a different person — but the video still used that CV's background.
fix: Background is only read from the CV when the agent didn't reject it; agent now raises warnings for HR.

found: Claude inferred “2 years of experience” from dates — not stated in the CV.
fix: Years are only accepted when the text literally states them.

found: Real course pages were rejected as “doesn't load”.
fix: Link checker uses the standard certificate bundle; 403 from bot-blocking sites counts as reachable, 404/DNS errors don't.

found: Agent picked only internal courses and never searched the web.
fix: Prompt requires 1–2 external courses found with web search; validator accepts only URLs from this run's search results.

found: Rubric shown to the employee revealed the hidden answers.
fix: Rubric must describe what is assessed, never the answers; answer key never sent to the browser.

found: Exercises were too long for new hires (40 min, 6+ rows).
fix: Short format: ~15 min, 3–5 rows, 2–3 questions, reference materials attached.
Word budget + one automatic “please shorten” retry, else labelled template narration.

found: A failed step for one employee blocked everyone else's preparation.
fix: Worker skips cases waiting for a retry.

found: Progress reviews failed: this model rejects forced tool choice.
fix: Ask + one reminder instead of forcing the tool.

found: Cloud server (512 MB) ran out of memory while rendering video.
fix: Encoder limited to 2 threads, 15 fps in the cloud; measured peak ≈ 340 MB.

found: Invitation failed: Gmail rejected the sender sign-in (wrong account configured).
fix: Clear error messages + HR-only email check page that tests the sign-in without sending.

found: Older invitation emails' passwords stopped working after a resend.
fix: Every emailed temporary password works until the employee sets their own.
